# Four.meme Source Snapshot

This directory records the provenance of the Four.meme official public token list collected on 2026 08 11.

The raw snapshot contains 1,000 unique token addresses. The API returned no rows after ten pages of 100 rows for each supported list type. This is a metadata validation snapshot, not full BNB Chain launch coverage.

Raw records are stored under `snapshot/` and excluded from Git. `SOURCE.json` records the exact request contract, row count, limitation, and SHA256 digest.

No decoded swaps are collected for this source.
